mechanism: Amikacin may impair levothyroxine absorption and increase renal elimination of levothyroxine, potentially reducing thyroid hormone levels; amikacin also carries ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity risks that may be exacerbated in hypothyroid patients.
action: Monitor TSH levels more frequently during and after amikacin therapy; adjust levothyroxine dose if needed; ensure adequate renal function monitoring given amikacin's nephrotoxicity.
